newChampionSummaryAudit.note: The patch says enemies hit, while DD specifies champions hit for resistances. This abbreviated wording alone cannot establish minion eligibility.

limitations: Existing 63 champions retain verified 16.17.1 client calculations with the listed official 26.18 changes applied; this is not a newly extracted 16.18 client dataset.
The five new Classic champions have original 16.18 descriptions and English names with the listed official prose overrides, but no verified full numeric client calculations or targeting context.
All 25 new skill summaries were compared with the official Classic patch; abbreviated wording or omitted details alone do not authorize a numeric or targeting-mechanic replacement.
Twisted Fate Q has a directly bound 1400 targeting line only; projectile candidates at 1450 have no direct Q firing binding and are not treated as cast distance.
Heimerdinger E and Nidalee human E ranges use official patch values 925 and 600; unchanged raw 16.18 Data Dragon values are 920 and 575.

Akali Q/R and Warwick R targeting indicators changed in 26.18 without an exact new targeting-context binding; old range presentations are hidden and raw Data Dragon ranges are not promoted to cast distances.
Bug-fix notes without numeric changes do not authorize invented numerical replacements.
